Phyllis Ngigi of the Gift of Chess programme adds that research shows the game helps prisoners learn patience and make better decisions, offering them a second chance.
items.title: Chess Gains Popularity as Rehabilitation Tool in Kenyan Prisons

items.summary: The price of CBAM certificates for the third quarter of 2026 reached EUR 82.32, an increase from around EUR 75 in the first two quarters. The European Commission calculates these prices based on EU ETS auction data. Firms importing specific goods from non-EU countries must pay carbon prices under the mechanism, which entered into force in January.
items.title: CBAM Certificate Prices Rise in 2026 Amid EU Carbon Rules

items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority (ITLA) and a ₹10,000-crore SME Growth Fund. The ITLA will coordinate transport planning and evaluate projects costing ₹500 crore or more. The SME fund aims to address the shortage of long-term equity capital for growth-stage enterprises. Officials stated these measures will strengthen infrastructure, reduce logistics costs, and support job creation. Experts noted that success depends on effective integration of ministry processes and the availability of patient capital for scaling businesses.
items.title: India Cabinet Approves Transport Authority and SME Fund

items.summary: Japan’s Agency for Natural Resources and Energy (ANRE) has proposed retaining feed-in support for specific commercial solar categories, including projects on public land and solar carports, while excluding industrial parks and former golf courses. The proposal aims to guide future deployment under new rules effective April 1, 2027, which will cut support for new ground-mounted commercial solar. ANRE assessed 10 candidate categories using tests for deployment importance, community compatibility, and scheme suitability. The agency also deferred a decision on agrivoltaics, pending further rule definitions regarding shading and spacing. Certification criteria and support prices are expected to be finalized between October and January 2027.
items.title: Japan Proposes Priority Categories for Commercial Solar Support

items.summary: German engineering startup Morreon GmbH has developed an AI-based operating system named Anchor to accelerate the planning and execution of complex energy infrastructure projects. The platform integrates document processing, engineering design, and project scheduling, specifically targeting battery energy storage systems and related infrastructure. Morreon CEO Alex Zwilling stated that the system ensures engineering integrity by flagging contradictions for human review rather than automatically resolving them. While the AI acts as a catalyst for data extraction and layout generation, the company emphasizes that professional engineers retain final responsibility for critical technical decisions and regulatory approvals. The platform currently covers the pre-construction process, with plans to extend into construction supervision.
items.title: German startup Morreon GmbH launches AI platform for battery storage engineering

items.summary: Max Estates reported total pre-sales of around Rs 2,100 crore for the July-September quarter of the 2026-27 fiscal year, a significant increase from Rs 156 crore in the same period a year earlier. The company attributed this growth to resilient underlying demand and plans for major launches in Noida and Gurugram.
items.title: Max Estates Reports Surge in Pre-Sales Bookings for Q3

items.summary: Captain Smit Machchhar, an Indian pilot for Flydubai, is recovering from a skull fracture and severe head injuries sustained during an attempted sabotage of his flight. According to CNN-News18, Machchhar fought off his Omani co-pilot, Al-Hammami, who attacked him with a crash axe. The co-pilot allegedly intended to kill or seriously injure the captain. Machchhar reports blurred vision and memory difficulties, describing his recollection as fragmented. While doctors conduct neurological assessments, a functionary noted the pilot is walking and eating, indicating a recovery course. India's ambassador to the UAE, Deepak Mittal, confirmed Machchhar is stable and chatting in the hospital. UAE and Israeli authorities have not yet commented on the ongoing investigation.
items.title: Flydubai Pilot Suffers Skull Fracture After Attempted Sabotage
